title: Confidence-Aware Robust Edge EMS: Reproducibility Software for Risk-Calibrated Multiobjective Tuning
description: Reproducibility software for confidence-aware, risk-calibrated, multiobjective tuning of an edge-executable battery-supported microgrid energy-management system under finite simulation budgets and distribution shift. The archived software release is tied to a closed confirmatory evidence chain with frozen validation, internal-test, ablation, sensitivity, and external-OOD provenance roots.
